name: displayxr-test-apps
description: Vulkan headers + loader for the Windows Vulkan test apps (cube_handle_vk_win / cube_zones_vk_win). Every other test app uses system SDKs (D3D11/D3D12/GL/Win32) and pulls nothing from vcpkg. The vk apps embed pre-built SPIR-V, so no glslang/glslangValidator is needed here.
